2607.15247.title: AutoSynthesis: An agentic system for automated meta-analysis
2607.15247.paper_summary: Evidence synthesis is crucial for turning primary research into reliable knowledge for science, medicine, education, and policy. Yet, quantitative evidence synthesis remains largely manual and difficult to scale. Here, we introduce AutoSynthesis, an end-to-end multi-agent system for automated meta-analysis. Given a research question in natural language, AutoSynthesis formulates a search strategy, retrieves scientific literature, screens candidate studies, assesses full-text eligibility, extracts quantitative statistics, computes standardized effect sizes, and finally performs random-effects meta-analysis. AutoSynthesis further supports heterogeneity analysis to examine how effect sizes vary across moderators, as well as risk-of-bias assessment. As output, AutoSynthesis produces a transparent report aligned with PRISMA guidelines. In our application, AutoSynthesis screened over 28 studies and extracted more than 20 quantitative claims. The pooled effect estimates produced by AutoSynthesis are similar to Hedges' $g$ of expert-conducted meta-analyses, indicating close agreement with manual evidence synthesis. Together, these results show that AutoSynthesis can make quantitative evidence synthesis more scalable, thereby supporting evidence-based decision-making across disciplines.
2607.15247.paper_summary_zh: 證據綜合對於將初級研究轉化為科學、醫學、教育和政策的可靠知識至關重要。<lb/>然而，定量證據綜合在很大程度上仍然是手動的，且難以擴展。<lb/>在此，我們介紹了 AutoSynthesis，一個端到端的多代理系統，用於自動化的元分析。<lb/>給定一個自然語言的研究問題，AutoSynthesis 制定搜索策略，檢索科學文獻，篩選候選研究，評估全文資格，提取定量統計數據，計算標準化效應大小，並最終執行隨機效應元分析。<lb/>AutoSynthesis 進一步支持異質性分析，以檢查效應大小如何隨調節變數而變化，以及偏見風險評估。<lb/>作為輸出，AutoSynthesis 生成一份符合 PRISMA 指南的透明報告。<lb/>在我們的應用中，AutoSynthesis 篩選了超過 28 項研究，並提取了超過 20 項定量主張。<lb/>AutoSynthesis 產生的合併效應估計與專家進行的元分析中的 Hedges' $g$ 相似，顯示出與手動證據綜合的高度一致。<lb/>綜合這些結果顯示，AutoSynthesis 可以使定量證據綜合更具可擴展性，從而支持跨學科的基於證據的決策制定。
